About

Active Accounting student at Universitas Muhammadiyah Yogyakarta (UMY) with a pesantren (Islamic boarding school) educational background, experienced in mentoring and teaching the Qur'an and with a deep understanding of tajwid and gharib sciences. Used to working both independently and in teams, with strong managerial, administrative, and coordination skills gained through student organizations, committees, and internship programs. Detail-oriented with good analytical skills, interested in finance, data management, and social activities, including concern for children's growth, development, and health rights. Actively developing myself through organizations, seminars, competitions, and training, and keen to contribute as a Liaison Officer (LO) providing the best guidance and service to participants, speakers, and event guests.
